question: Related Questions Q. I'm suffering from a disease wherein Nasal passage gets blocked causing difficulty in breathing. Everybody advise me to stay away from the practice as it is forbidden and may cause break in roza. The problem is that after getting this treated in various systems of medicine, I could not get a perfect treatment. The temporary solution is only to pour nasal drop.Without which I find it extremely difficult to breath. Ultimately I need to pour nasal drop in my blocked nose. I'm in dilemma if pouring nasal drop during Ramzan fast is forbidden what would happen to my past rozas'; I'm still can not do without nasal decongenstant during this ramzan roza also. Please clearly advise me wheter pouring medicine in nose under my circumstance is strictly forbidden. What else should i do ? answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 7339 Country: India Title: My name is Mohammad Irshad I need to know whether it's allowed to go for Tableeg (10 Days) in Ramadaan Month. If we go then tarveeh would be distrubed. Question: Assalaamuleyikum, My name is Mohammad Irshad I need to know whether it's allowed to go for Tableeg (10 Days) in Ramadaan Month. If we go then tarveeh would be distrubed. Jazaakumulllah! Answer ID: 7339 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 862/862=M/1429) There is no wrong in going out in Tabligh if there is any hafiz with you. Perform the tarawih behind the hafiz, or the Jamat stays in a mosque where you perform the tarawih in a mosque and stay there until the Quran completes. If there is no such arrangement, then you should complete the Quran anywhere in tarawih and then go out for Tabligh, but keep on performing the tarawih whenever you go as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
